name: TeamLease Services Ltd
title: TeamLease Services Ltd - 539658 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Staffing volume fell on one NBFC insourcing, but PAPM rose to INR689 from INR669 and management guides FY27 EBITDA growth above 20% on operating leverage, with a 10,000-head low-margin exit in H1.

triggers.label: PAPM INR669 → INR689 in general staffing
triggers.quote: general staffing, which moved to INR689 in Q4 from INR669 in Q1

triggers.label: FY27 EBITDA growth above 20%
triggers.quote: we will be able to maintain year-on-year EBITDA growth of over 20% for FY27

triggers.label: Planned exit of ~10,000 low-margin heads
triggers.quote: there is a planned exit of about 10,000 headcount between our staffing and DA businesses in Q1 and Q2 of FY27

triggers.label: Open positions up 15–20% QoQ
triggers.quote: we are starting this year with more open positions than we had in the pre vious quarter

guidance.quote: we will be able to maintain year-on-year EBITDA growth of over 20% for FY27

guidance.value: positive at end H1 FY27 and full year
guidance.quote: we are confident of ending H1 FY27 with positive headcount

red_flags.label: EPFO/PF Trust demand ~INR180 crore under dispute
red_flags.quote: there is a demand of about INR180 crores pertaining to how the process or the offsetting of profits and loss were done in the PF Trust level

red_flags.label: Q4 HR services segment profit dip YoY
red_flags.quote: performance seems to be weaker than last year

evasions.quote: Let me connect to you separately.
It's too early. It's too premature.
